sections.title: Be with personal subjects
sections.body:
Use am after I, is after a singular third-person subject, and are after you, we or they. Put not directly after be.

sections.title: Subject and object pronouns
sections.body:
A subject pronoun goes before the verb. Use an object pronoun after a verb or a preposition.

Подлежащее называет исполнителя действия. После глагола или предлога нужны формы me, him, her, us, them.

title: Possessive determiners

sections.title: Possessive determiners
sections.body:
Place my, your, his, her, its, our or their before a noun. Choose the form for the owner.

Притяжательное определение выбирают по владельцу. После него идёт существительное, а артикль перед ним не нужен.

• They brought their books.
• I forgot my umbrella.

Частая ошибка
She lost she ticket → She lost her ticket. Перед ticket нужно определение владельца.

sections.title: This and those
sections.body:
Use this and that with a singular noun, these and those with plural nouns. This and these point to something near the speaker.

Различайте число и расстояние. Для предметов вдали используйте that или those, для находящихся рядом — this или these.

Examples
• This key in my hand is yours.
• Those lights across the river are new.

Частая ошибка

title: Present simple routines
description: В утвердительном Present Simple ставьте -s или -es у глагола после he, she, it. После согласной y меняется на -ies.
instructions: Read the rule and examples. Complete all eight tasks. For text answers enter only the missing form.

sections.title: Present simple routines
sections.body:
Use the base verb for I, you, we and they in positive present statements. With he, she or it add the third-person ending.

В утвердительном Present Simple ставьте -s или -es у глагола после he, she, it. После согласной y меняется на -ies.

Examples
• I cycle to class every day.
• My neighbour studies after work.

Частая ошибка
